sourceScopeNotes: Every run verifies current first-party legal employer and careers/joblist delegation, exact public listing/detail/application clients, the unfiltered listing and closing snapshot. Each published role is expanded through its native identity and the client-declared public PDF before caps. Formal RRF, full PDF criteria and explicit work country remain distinct from posting identity, corporate country and unknown job dates/work arrangement. Current successful empty feed can establish runtime empty inventory; HTTP500 or access denial cannot. Nonempty live detail/PDF coverage has not been observed in the current empty source; synthetic controls are separate evidence. Additional hiring paths or unknown work country preserve partial scope and disable cleanup.
